verdict.rationale: Supabase documents Read Replicas as additional databases kept in sync with the primary, used for load balancing, latency and redundancy, so the read-replica half of the story is delivered first-party. The evidence pack contains nothing on high-availability or failover behavior (automatic promotion, failover timing, RPO/RTO), so that half is unevidenced. Daily backups are a different capability and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented HA/failover behavior, replica setup steps and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can add read replicas and rely on documented high-availability and failover behavior

citations.quote: Read Replicas are additional databases kept in sync with your Primary database.
